SELECTED PROJECTS

Built for demanding environments.

Representative work, grouped by engineering domain. Open a project for the challenge, contribution and outcome.

01 / REMOTE VESSEL SYSTEMMARINE
CONTROL
MARINE / EMBEDDED2021–2022

Indian Navy target-ship control system

Rebuilt a remote vessel-control architecture spanning onboard electronics, communications, mechanical throttle integration and an operator station.

Read project story ↗

Challenge: Restore and integrate a target vessel’s control functions after seawater damage to the original electronics.

My contribution: Embedded boards and firmware, CAN-interface investigation, throttle feedback, distributed control, operator software and the ruggedized remote station.

Outcome: Demonstrated with Indian Navy personnel, trialled offshore and deployed on the vessel. Further copies were reported by the project owner; publication of fleet details requires confirmation.

02 / RESONANT POWER
POWER ELECTRONICSONGOING

Industrial induction-heating controller

A feedback-driven controller for resonant induction systems, developed through switching experiments, sensing and firmware iterations.

Read project story ↗

Challenge: Keep a changing resonant load in the intended switching region while regulating the heating process.

My contribution: Controller PCB, STM32 firmware, gate timing, waveform feedback, frequency search and PID-based target control. Related induction design and configuration work was carried out with Francis Sir.

Status: Continuing industrial development; exact power ratings and performance depend on the specific machine and revision.

03 / THERMAL CONTROL
MEDICAL EQUIPMENT DEVELOPMENT2026

Forced-air patient warmer

Reworked a basic heating concept into an integrated blower, heater, filtration and closed-loop control system.

Read project story ↗

Challenge: Improve airflow and temperature control for a warming-blanket application.

My contribution: Blower and heater selection, mechanical air path, control PCB, touchscreen HMI, firmware, temperature control and filter integration.

Outcome: The project owner reports personally building approximately ten units. Clinical clearance and quantified performance are not asserted here.

04 / THREE-PHASE MONITORING
INDUSTRIAL IOT2022

Three-phase IoT MCB & energy monitor

Remote switching and electrical measurement combined in a custom enclosure, calibrated against the client’s reference setup.

Read project story ↗

Requirement: Remotely operate an MCB and record three-phase electrical consumption.

My contribution: Measurement PCB, current and voltage sensing, power architecture, motorized switching, firmware, dashboard and enclosure.

Validation: Calibration work was performed using IDEMI reference equipment; final deployment details remain to be confirmed.

05 / DIRECTIONAL DETECTION
BARC / MECHATRONICSCONCEPT PROTOTYPE

Mobile gamma-detection mechanism

Translated a paper concept into a motorized, directional sensor housing with a camera-mounting arrangement.

Read project story ↗

My contribution: Mechanical body, shielding enclosure concept, gearing, motor and driver selection, controller integration and motion automation.

Boundary: Mechanical and motion functions were tested. The project owner did not perform radioactive-source or gamma-sensor validation; this is not presented as a certified detector.

06 / ANALYTICAL INSTRUMENTpH
LABORATORY ELECTRONICS2026

Touchscreen pH measurement platform

Precision analogue sensing, temperature compensation, calibration logic and a touchscreen interface in one instrument-development program.

Read project story ↗

My contribution: Firmware and user interface, pH signal-chain iterations, PT100 temperature-sensing board, ADC integration and calibration work.

Development path: Moved from an off-the-shelf amplifier toward a custom differential front end as accuracy issues emerged. Final specifications require measured validation.

07 / PRECISION POWER10V100 A · CC / CV
BARC / POWER ELECTRONICSDELIVERED

Precision high-current DC supply

A 10 V, 100 A constant-current/constant-voltage supply with digitally set output and calibration against a precision meter.

Read project story ↗

My contribution: Power-supply design, transformer and high-current stage, microcontroller/DAC control of CC/CV setpoints, calibration and delivery.

Outcome: The project owner reports delivering three units for BARC. Exact calibration figures are not published without test records.

08 / INDUSTRIAL CONTROLPLC
BARC-RELATED / AUTOMATIONSTATUS TO CONFIRM

Industrial cooler control system

System architecture, PLC card, HMI and firmware for coordinated equipment control and operator interaction.

Read project story ↗

My contribution: Defined how the system should operate, designed the PLC and HMI, wrote firmware, and integrated sensor and communications paths.

Publication note: Final operating sequence, commissioning outcome and approved client wording are still being confirmed.

HOW I WORK

A project is more than a schematic.

My work often begins with an incomplete requirement, a failed legacy product, or an application that has never been built locally. I connect the electrical, firmware, mechanical and operational decisions—then test the complete system where it will actually be used.

01Understand the applicationConstraints, operators, environment, failure modes.
02Engineer across disciplinesCircuits, controls, mechanics and interface together.
03Prove it in operationBench tests, revisions, field trials and handover.
